headline:
إضافة Dreamlight Valley
تحوّلك إلى حورية بحر
label: رسمي
spoken: إضافة Dreamlight Valley تحوّلك إلى حورية بحر، اسمها The Keepsake Sea. تزيّن فيها عالمك تحت الماء، وتلتقي هناك Dory، وتبحر بسفينتك الخاصة.

angle.hook: a Disney life-sim expansion that turns your character into a mermaid (Steam: 'Become a magical mermaid'), with Dory, Jack Sparrow and Megara
angle.why_now: the expansion launches Wednesday 18 Nov 2026 (official page 'LAUNCHES NOVEMBER 18, 2026'; Steam app 5090170 release 18 Nov), two days after this 00:15 Dubai Monday slot; date first announced at the Disney Dreamlight Valley 2026 Showcase, 21 Oct 2026
angle.what_it_means_here: players of Disney Dreamlight Valley in the region get the new expansion on Wednesday; it needs the base game (official page '*Requires base game to play'); Steam shows no price yet
angle.payoff: an underwater world you decorate yourself, Dory, and your own pirate ship

story_type_items.RELEASE (dated launch): date 18 Nov 2026 from the official expansion page and Steam; requires the base game (official page); price: not listed on Steam (coming soon, no price) nor on the official page, so not on screen
story_type_items.TRAILER: the expansion's own official 'Full Trailer' on its Steam page (app 5090170, uploaded 21 Oct 2026 18:03Z), Gameloft, credited «المصدر: جيملوفت (Gameloft)» on every shot from frame 0

sensitive: none: a family Disney life sim; no weapons gripped, no skull flag shots used (the pirate-flag crow's-nest and ship-deck cannon shots 4 to 9 s and 21 to 28 s were left out); Captain Hook shots (14 to 16 s, 64 to 70 s) left out
